This quality inspection report documents the verification of manufacturing processes and output quality for
Batch SLM-WSH-316L-230815-33, comprising 33 units of 316L stainless steel flat washers produced via
Selective Laser Melting. The inspection covered material handling, process parameters, energy utilization, and
final product quality against internal specification AM-QS-316L-Rev4 and customer requirements.

batch records. All material movements were tracked using the facility’s material traceability system (MTS-AM

finished product yield, with 71.5% of input powder successfully recovered for reuse. Energy consumption
patterns aligned with equipment specifications and historical baselines.
Overall Assessment: PROCESS APPROVED - All quality parameters within acceptable limits.

4.2 Process Efficiency Metrics
The SLM process operated for 13.38 hours to complete the 33-component build cycle. Energy consumption per
component averaged 1.97 kWh, consistent with equipment performance specifications.
Industry Benchmark: Typical SLM energy consumption ranges from 1.8-2.2 kWh per similar component in
industry surveys.
5.0 Product Quality Assessment
5.1 Final Product Specifications
The batch produced 33 flat washers meeting all specified requirements. Product verification included
dimensional inspection, visual examination, and material composition confirmation.

3.2 Process Water Management
The water atomization process utilized 16.8 kg of process water for cooling during powder production. Water
recovery systems successfully captured and treated 16.4 kg for reuse in subsequent cycles, representing a
97.6% recovery rate.
Historical Comparison: Previous quarter average recovery rate: 96.2% ±1.3%
4.0 Energy Utilization Analysis
4.1 Electrical Consumption
Energy consumption was monitored throughout the manufacturing cycle using calibrated power analyzers
(Fluke 437 Series II). All measurements were verified against equipment specifications.
